description: If \(T\vdash A\) and \(U\cup\{A\}\vdash B\), then \(T\cup U\vdash B\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.derives_cut.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {T U : Set (L.Formula α)} {A B : L.Formula α} (hA : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T A)
  (hB : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives (insert A U) B) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives (T ∪ U) B
